requested_analysis: patient-level external validation of melanoma BRAF-pathway score
blocking_reason: The repository freezes an EGFR-mutant NSCLC resistance signature/CRI, but does not define a melanoma-specific score with frozen features, weights, normalization, and endpoint before inspecting GSE196434.

available_cohort_evidence.design: PRE/POST melanoma metastases with long-response versus short-response groups

required_before_validation: prespecify melanoma feature set and biological rationale
freeze score weights and normalization using development data only
define the primary endpoint and time origin
define patient-level aggregation for repeated PRE/POST samples
stratify or prespecify handling of BRAFi versus BRAFi+MEKi
run the frozen score once on GSE196434 without refitting
interpretation: GSE196434 remains a phenotype-replication cohort until a melanoma score is frozen independently of this cohort.
